notes.title: Screensavers v1.0 is out!
notes.content:
Our wild experiment is LIVE! Our tiny FLOAT LAND team has put together the seeds of something truly wonderful, and as our first publicly available project, I'm tremendously proud.

This is not just about technology, it's about the humans behind it, and about the unpredictable, creative outbursts that occur at unique moments with unique individuals. This is about embracing creative opportunities in amazing new technologies like VR and AR.

We've done a lot of experimental work in VR and are excited to evolve these classics and build new ideas for your screens, bodies, and minds!  We're planning to update frequently... stay tuned for more announcements. Thanks for being here.
- team FLOAT LAND 

FAQ 
Q: Is this really just a screensaver in VR?
A: Nope, unless that's what you want! It is quite fun to see them spatialized in 3D, but we've made each one interactive in different ways, given you real-time control over parameters, added easter eggs, and are adding more as we go!

Q: Is it a game? 
A: Maybe! We are adding mini-games and story elements which will be revealed over time. We are currently on version 1.0 and want to incorporate your feedback on what to build alongside all the things we have in the pipe. We're excited to share more soon.

Q: What do you have in the pipe?
A: No one has ever answered the question of "What is in the pipes?". We will do that.
A part 2: Oh you meant what is in our production pipeline? I'm glad you asked: 

Roadmap:
* A software manual written by an alumni of The Onion
* "Evening Dreams" DLC inspired by the classic After Dark
* Collaborations with artists and designers -- some talents you've probably heard of, and some you haven't! (yet) 
* More comfort modes for chillin out 
* More navigation modes and custimzation for extreme VR'ers!
* lots more but this list is getting long now

Q: How do I give feedback?
A: Drop your suggestions in the Steam forums or in our Discord! https://discord.gg/zyuQhkg
